description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the IDGeneratorDao component of the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to generating and retrieving the current ID values for different entities within the HRM system, such as Employee, Module, and User.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that validates the behavior of IDGeneratorDao methods, ensuring correct ID retrieval and updates for entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of IDGeneratorDao, and populates test data from a fixture.

methods.name: testGetCurrentID
methods.description: Tests that the current ID retrieved for Employee, Module, and User entities matches expected values.

methods.name: testUpdateNextId
methods.description: Tests that updating the next ID for an Employee entity works correctly and that the current ID reflects this change.
